# JS sync-surface gaps — canonical MCP tools WITHOUT a SyncToolDispatcher
# handler (the JS wrapper exists, the call dies with 'Unsupported tool').
#
# Ratchet: this list may only SHRINK. A new tool landing in the MCP
# catalog without a sync executor fails js_sync_surface_parity_test;
# closing a gap requires removing its line here in the same PR.
#
# Provenance: first frozen 2026-09-18 by the surface-parity probe
# (test/js_sync_surface_parity_test.dart); 289/420 names. Root cause:
# wrappers are generated for the whole registry while the sync bridge
# was grown agent-surface-first (Java exposes all @MCPTool to JS).
